label: D2 after choosing a2, in the last ~8 trials of the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), only when this trial chose a2 (in_action == 2 at D2, so observed), and only very late in the episode: 99% of mass is at ep_trial 90-99, none before trial 80. Equivalently it fires only when the value head is low (< 5.22, the bottom bin, which is end-of-episode). Rate is higher when the previous trial was also a2 (stay runs of a2) and when start_high=1 (S2 good late). Never fires at D1/GO, after a1 choices, or on rewarded-input steps. Within the window activations tend to grow across consecutive a2 trials and with ep_trial (seen in examples, not quantified). Simplest predicate D2 & a2 & ep_trial>=91 gets dev F1 0.75; adding prev_action != 1 and ep_trial>=92 gives dev F1 0.80, mass recall 0.94. Precision ~0.72 is limited by the soft onset time near trial 90-92. All variables are observed (ep_trial is a time/clock signal the agent may track).
